title: Four responses, different effects on risk
teachingQuestion: What does each response change, and what responsibility remains?
focalInsight: A response changes exposure or its consequences; acceptance still needs an authorized owner.
caption: A response changes exposure or its consequences; acceptance still needs an authorized owner.

nodes.label: Avoid
nodes.definition: Stop or decline the activity producing the specified exposure.
nodes.decision: Compare the forgone business benefit with the exposure avoided.
nodes.failureExample: Cancel the sensitive-data collection instead of protecting unnecessary records.
nodes.detail: Stop or decline the activity producing the specified exposure.

nodes.label: Mitigate
nodes.definition: Reduce likelihood, impact, or both with safeguards.
nodes.decision: Choose effective, proportionate controls and verify operation.
nodes.failureExample: Segmentation limits propagation but does not eliminate all compromise paths.
nodes.detail: Reduce likelihood, impact, or both with safeguards.

nodes.label: Transfer / share
nodes.definition: Allocate specified consequences through insurance, contract or another arrangement.
nodes.decision: Check scope, exclusions, counterparty capability and retained duties.
nodes.failureExample: An insurance policy pays certain losses but does not restore customer trust.
nodes.detail: Allocate specified consequences through insurance, contract or another arrangement.

nodes.label: Accept
nodes.definition: An authorized owner knowingly retains the exposure under defined conditions.
nodes.decision: Check delegated authority, tolerance, duration and review trigger.
nodes.failureExample: An engineer silently waives a high-impact control without approval.
nodes.detail: An authorized owner knowingly retains the exposure under defined conditions.

nodes.label: Residual risk
nodes.definition: Exposure remaining after treatment is considered.
nodes.decision: Evaluate whether the remaining exposure meets acceptance criteria.
nodes.failureExample: Deploying a control is mistaken for proving that the remaining risk is acceptable.
nodes.detail: Exposure remaining after treatment is considered.
